author: bardic-inspiration
name: Ruins of Prod
summary: A small abandoned village on a hilltop, overrun by insects and restless dead.
description: Prod was emptied by a plague of bugs a generation ago, and nobody moved back. The road to Testmore Keep runs straight through it.

zones.name: Hill Path
zones.note: The way in, a switchback track up the hill from the road.

zones.name: Market Square
zones.note: Empty stalls under a dry well, buzzing with flies.

zones.name: Hive Hollow
zones.note: Rotting houses packed with wasp paper and beetle tunnels.

zones.name: Collapsed Chapel
zones.note: Only the bell tower still stands.

zones.name: Graveyard
zones.note: Toppled stones and freshly turned earth.
